name: watch.cancel
description: End a watch.* subscription by id. Idempotent — already-cancelled or never-existed subscription_ids return success without error (the post-condition is identical: the id no longer streams events).

subscription_id.description: Subscription identifier in `sub:N` form, sourced from any watch.* verb's response.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: agent_native
x-implementations.description: Handled inline by the agent's subscription registry. Looks up the subscription_id, signals its cancellation event, and removes it from the registry. No OS-level call.

windows-modern.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. Idempotent on missing / already-cancelled ids.

windows-classic.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. Idempotent on missing / already-cancelled ids.
